seo: eBay Store setup, design and categories
meta: Your eBay Store designed and organized: banner, store categories, policies and featured items. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay Store setup, from design to categories
overview: An eBay Store gives buyers one tidy place to browse your items. We set up your store in your own eBay account: name and web address options, banner and logo, store categories that make sense, featured listings and a short About section. We also set your return, shipping and payment policies. You choose the store subscription tier directly with eBay, and we guide you on which one fits your volume.

pkgs.blurb: A branded eBay Store with clear categories.
A fuller store with featured items and sorted listings.
A complete store, with promotions, a header and a style guide.

faq: Do I need an eBay Store subscription?
It is optional. A store gives lower fees in some categories and extra tools, but costs a monthly fee. We compare your sales volume against the tiers so you can decide if it pays off.
Can you set up the store if I have no listings yet?
Yes. We build the design and category tree first, then your listings drop in as you add them. Add the listing creation service if you also want us to write the first items.
Can I use my brand's logo?
Yes, if you own it or have the right to use it. Send us the files, or we make a simple text logo. We cannot use another brand's name or logo in your store design, as eBay forbids that.
Will the store look good on mobile?
Yes. eBay shows stores in its own mobile layout, so we design the banner to crop well and keep text short and centered. We check it on a phone before we hand it over.
